rcPromoted.note: Phase 11 must promote the exact 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate before beta activation.

productionBackupConfigured.note: Provider-level automatic backups must be verified. The provider audit on 2026-09-03 found zero configured schedules and zero visible backups, so this inherited RC gate remains blocked until Railway is configured and fresh evidence exists.

restoreDrillVerified.note: A dated non-destructive provider-level restore drill is required. This gate is inherited from RC_READINESS.json and must not be promoted independently.

productionAlertingVerified.evidence: GitHub Actions run 33467741703 (success) + closed synthetic drill issue #115 on 2026-09-01
productionAlertingVerified.note: Inherited from Phase 11: an isolated synthetic readiness failure was detected, escalated through the GitHub incident API and automatically closed without mutating production.

paymentRailVerified.note: At least one intended beta payment rail must be verified with controlled real funds movement. This gate is inherited from RC_READINESS.json and must not be promoted independently.

cartagenaVetCoverageVerified.note: At least three verified and active veterinarians must have Cartagena as their service city. Use the admin-only GET /api/beta/readiness runtime snapshot as redacted count evidence.

clientCohortConfigured.note: The initial cohort is managed through the append-only admin control plane (GET/POST /api/beta/cohort), not provider environment hashes. Keep this gate pending until real verified CLIENT accounts have been invited and the admin readiness snapshot proves the intended cohort count and eligibility.

supportOwnerConfirmed.note: Runtime treats both NVET_BETA_SUPPORT_OWNER and NVET_BETA_SUPPORT_CHANNEL as machine activation gates, but keep this evidence pending until a named owner, monitored route, approver and date are confirmed using CARTAGENA_BETA_OPERATIONS_RUNBOOK.md.

privacyAndTermsReviewed.note: Versioned beta terms/privacy drafts and an explicit append-only acceptance path exist. Keep pending until the responsible legal/privacy review is documented; implementation alone is not approval.

rollbackDrillVerified.note: The kill-switch contract is implemented and documented. Keep pending until a provider-level drill proves NVET_BOOKING_ENABLED=false stops new bookings while authentication and history remain available, then restores normal beta gating.
